title: My internet drops after connecting to the VPN
description: As soon as I connect to the VPN my internet stops working, only internal company services open.

worklogs.description: Reviewed the VPN profile file — 'Use default gateway on remote network' is checked.
Compared the route table before/after; when the VPN connects, 0.0.0.0/0 goes to the VPN gateway.
Updated the split tunneling profile, only corp.local subnets go through the VPN.
5-minute test session with the user: internet and corp services work at the same time.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hi, this is a classic sign that the VPN client is running in 'full tunnel' mode — meaning all your traffic goes through the VPN and access to the external internet is cut off. Could you disconnect your VPN so I can push a profile update?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Okay, I've disconnected. I don't mind being without internet for about half an hour, go ahead and test.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Thanks. I switched your profile to 'split tunneling' mode — now only the corp.local subnets (10.10.0.0/16, 192.168.50.0/24) go through the VPN, and all remaining traffic goes directly over the internet. Could you download and install the new profile? You can access it from this link: [vpn-profile-v2.ovpn]

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I installed the new profile and connected. Internet works now 👍 But I'm wondering if I can reach the corp wiki, could you check?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The wiki URL is 'wiki.corp.local'. Please open it in your browser and let me know whether it 'works' or 'doesn't open'. Also try the address 'fileshare.corp.local'.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Both opened! Internet and corp services are working at the same time. Perfect. Thank you so much.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Great. The issue is resolved. I've saved the profile, so from now on this setup will apply automatically every time you connect. If anything goes wrong, just write to me again.

resolutionNote: Updated the VPN profile from 'full tunnel' to 'split tunneling'. Only the corp.local subnets (10.10.0.0/16, 192.168.50.0/24) pass through the VPN; remaining traffic goes over the user's local internet connection. Tested live together with the user.
